milestone: Smoother unit steering and slower quadrotors
emscripten: emcc (Emscripten gcc/clang-like replacement + linker emulating GNU ld) 6.0.9 (4e4223852a0835923411059a3929907d7df1232e)
changes: Shared C steering state eases body yaw and pitch with bounded angular velocity and acceleration.
Ground/naval motion slows into sharp turns; aircraft retain forward progress on their validated routes.
Quadrotor cruise pace reduced from 3.2 to 0.65 route segments/second; gunship remains 2.55 and transport 1.9.
Rendered orientation, odometry and sensor mounts consume the same steering state. Pause freezes steering; new worlds and inspection-tour changes reset it.

sensors.scope: Sensor sampling and observation packing only. 9 units, 3 generated worlds, 1800 steps at 60 Hz, including an underground scout. Generation, route/pose preparation, rendering and training are excluded. Finite-observation checks are included. Optimized native timing uses process CPU time; Node timing is Emscripten clock(). No CUDA throughput claim.
